apps/web/src/features/wiki/ArticleSessio.reason: Reading progress is saved at coarse steps, so the furthest point read since the last step is sent when the reader closes or reloads the tab. Only pagehide fires then, a server action dies with the page, and the page-event registry owns only keydown and beforeunload (which prompts); the listener is added and removed with the measurement of the article column it belongs to.
